namaz_guide_details:
Calculation Method of Lifetime Missed Salah To calculate the lifetime missed Salah male and female both should count number of missed Salah from the date of puberty.

If date of puberty is not known then as per lunar year (Islamic year) for male at age of 12 and for female from the age of 9 will be calculated to count number of missed Salah.

Woman will have to pay attention on these things as well:

Woman don't count Salah of monthlies (menses) days.

Year in which child is born, in pregnancy months monthlies days will be counted. Although, month in which child is born so, after that Nifas (post-natal bleeding) days will not be counted.

Few important things: Only Fard Raka't of daily 5 Salah are counted in missed Salah whereas Witr of Isha Salah should be performed as well.

Total numbers of Raka't of one day missed Salah are 20: 2 Farz e Fajar, 4 Farz e Zuhr, 4 Farz e Asr, 3 Farz e Maghrib, 4 Farz e Isha, 3 Witr.

App related instructions:

According to the method of missed Salah calculate your Salah and submit it in the field of Salah given in the application so that, you can track your missed Salah in the application.

Perform missed Salah and keep on deducting them in the application and if you miss Salah in the future then you can add it.

Number of fasts that have been missed can be submitted in the field of fast given in the application so that, you can track your missed fast in the application. Observe missed fast and keep on deducting them in the application and if you miss fast in the future then you can add it.

To know more information related to Missed Salah study the booklet of Ameer-e-Ahlesunnat "Method of Missed Salah"
